data.title: Carta QR
data.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for restaurants with QR menu, in-table ordering, cash-register management and analytics. Layered architecture (Repository → Use Case → Server Action) using Next.js 16 Server Actions. Realtime via Soketi/Pusher WebSockets, Auth.js + Google OAuth + RBAC, Zod validation, and a testing suite with Vitest + Playwright + axe-core + Testcontainers.

data.title: Boston automotores
data.description: Public website + admin panel for a car dealership (real client, in active production use). Vehicle catalog with brand, price and mileage filters; inventory management, technical sheets, lead capture and email notifications.

data.title: Pathfinder
data.description: Web application for tabletop RPG battle management (Pathfinder / D&D 5e). Canvas-based maps with Konva, initiative tracking, conditions, spells and scenario persistence. Layer system, PostgreSQL persistence, multi-user. High-performance canvas rendering with Konva.js. Layered architecture.

data.title: Tu Amigo FI
data.description: Collaborative platform for UNMdP Engineering students. Share practical material, midterm exams, answers and comments across degrees and years. Complex domain modeling: degrees, study plans, terms, prerequisites. Google OAuth, user moderation, file uploads, search and department filtering. Built with real student feedback gathered during usage.

data.title: Bowling de Paso
data.description: Public website for a bowling venue (real client, in active production use). Responsive design, WhatsApp channel integration, LocalBusiness schema cards and optimised OpenGraph. Technical SEO: JSON-LD, sitemap, metadata. Image optimisation and performance tuning.

data.title: Helados Italia
data.description: First professional project (kept as a learning milestone). Static website for a local ice cream shop, built from scratch with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Product catalog and responsive design.
